test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. A is not sitting at any of the corners and is second to the right of H. G is sitting at one of the comers and is sitting fourth to the left to C. E and B are the immediate neighbours of C. F is sitting at one of the corners and is to the immediate left of B.

Who among the following are the immediate neighbours of H?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) G is sitting at one of the comers and is sitting fourth to the left to C.

2) E and B are the immediate neighbors of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ad2ea71e992017500f4b16f43d9dae0ff5c9b812160186d43e4901db26985d.png] 

3) F is sitting at one of the corners and is to the immediate left of B.

4) A is not sitting at any of the corners and is second to the right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6999c636861e645fce8a43ac0ba5f614183bfc2d88be6f066aebfc6425b16381.png] 

And, D will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fae4a0bf45f3545cbdf6f82e1733ac8a0cd93a17712834f8b33c41e5003cca9d.png] 

Here, **'D and G'** are the immediate neighbors of H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
